dataset.title: DFO Pacific: Herring Biosample Database
dataset.abstract: Herring biological (fish and sample) data as part of Herring Stock Assessment database

taxonomicCoverage.generalTaxonomicCoverage: The Pacific herring, Clupea pallasii, is a species of the herring family associated with the Pacific Ocean environment of North America and northeast Asia.
